title: Store a value under a key
summary: A key is a name used to find a value. SET stores a string, and GET reads that string back.
introduction: A key is a name used to find a value. SET stores a string, and GET reads that string back. Your task: Store and read another sample club name.
learningObjectives: Store and read another sample club name.

blocks.text: A key is a name used to find a value. SET stores a string, and GET reads that string back.
Use a local Redis server and redis-cli. Commands here use cma: practice keys only. Redis commands do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Do not connect these exercises to a production database.

blocks.title: Store a value under a key

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: SET puts the text value under the cma:club key.
GET reads that exact key; the cma prefix helps identify practice data.

blocks.text: SET replies OK. GET returns Garden club.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A key belongs to this Redis database, not your browser. Use a prefix to keep practice values easy to identify.
